create_sha256_hash: create a SHA-256 hash of any picklable Python object using pickle serialization
create_sha256_cbor_hash: create a SHA-256 hash of Python objects using canonical CBOR serialization
create_xxhash: create a fast xxHash of picklable Python objects using xxh3_128 digest
create_xxhash_cbor: create a fast xxHash of objects serialized with canonical CBOR
run_get_hash_fn_by_name: run get_hash_fn_by_name to retrieve a hash function by string name like sha256 or xxhash
